kind: Independent read-only operator harness lifecycle review
qualification: This is source/helper control review, not an actual host containment or scientific approval
Actual Linux mount/umount, UID/gofer readability, cgroup cleanup and case outcomes still need source-bound worker evidence
The20-case matrix alone does not establish separate controller-crash/recovery, late queued launch or all real tamper/image-mismatch gates
No-NAT/metadata helpers have a separate independent reviewer; this review does not re-claim their current cloud-state proof

resolved_finding.issue: First bind mount could take effect before subprocess/log-retention acknowledgement, leaving mounted=False and a false cleanup claim
resolved_finding.resolution: MountIntent is retained before effects, attempted before invocation; trusted kernel mountinfo and source/target identities reconcile absence/unmount. Missing/stale/unowned/stacked observations fail closed. Internal-only util-linux arguments bound direct-child timeout reasoning.

reviewed_boundaries: stage_inputs copies exact approved bytes before application-owner chown; files0400/dir0500; rootjob0700
materialized rootfs and actual OCI blobs bound before per-job bind/remount readonly and profile construction
cgroup cleanup reacquires durable effect lock and requires retained create_intent device/inode before kill/populated0/removal
rootfs cleanup is physical mount reconciliation rather than a successful-command or mounted-flag assumption
unique create-only attempts preserve failed pipeline/log observations; raw-retention/pipeline failures force case failure
numerical repetition binds image/environment plus exact runtime/init/adapter pins and normalized policy/resources
operator synthetic fixtures explicitly deny real C22 reservation/approval, production dispatch, scientific approval and component completion

targeted_independent_check.command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_experiment_sandbox_operator_acceptance.py -q --tb=short -k 'bind_effect or unmount or mountinfo or numerical_repetition_requires'
